environment.execution: One benchmark process at a time; affinity/power/background load uncontrolled; filesystem/import caches may be OS-warm; no cross-host comparison.

conditions.data: Fixed tokens repeated by cell width (or column count for long-input stress); four row styles.
conditions.windows: Setup/old-front prime outside each timed operation; perf_counter_ns; GC enabled; tracemalloc in separate untimed whole-sample windows.
conditions.capabilities: Interactive Unicode, RGB24, cursor hidden at 0,0, final column reserved.
conditions.cache: Warm imports/styles/text; representative row inputs fit the 1024-code-point metrics cache. Long-input stress may bypass that cache.
conditions.composition: Two opaque layers; bottom-right 16x2 overlay; damage includes overlay.
conditions.resize: From each base size to +/-8 columns and +/-2 rows; same-content resize.
conditions.statistics: Nearest-rank p95, MAD, min/max; stage medians are not additive.
conditions.memory: Whole sample including setup and controls; live blocks are not allocation churn or RSS.
conditions.allocations: Cell constructor calls inside instrumented preparation, not total Python allocation churn.
conditions.limits: No widgets/layout/application/domain, native I/O, emulator/SSH/ConPTY, input-to-visible latency, arbitrary style counts or cross-platform performance.
